description: Junior reviewer finds a type-safety bug (any usage) and a logic error, but misses a race condition. Decent reasoning for junior level.

prContext.title: Add candidate scoring utility
prContext.description: Adds a computeScore helper that averages review scores.
prContext.instructions: Review for correctness and type safety.

groundTruth.description: cached returned as any — defeats type safety. Should parse/validate cached value.
No cache key normalization — scores [1,2] and [2,1] produce different cache keys but same statistical result. Wasteful and incorrect for unordered data.
Missing error handling if setCache throws. Promise rejection will bubble unhandled.

reviewer_comments.what: Returning cached as any loses type safety.
reviewer_comments.why: We should validate the cached value is a number before returning.

reviewer_comments.what: computeScore returns 0 for empty array. Should this be NaN or null instead?
reviewer_comments.why: An empty array average is mathematically undefined.

rounds.reviewer_summary: Two suggestions to address before merge.

implementer_responses.content: I think 0 is fine for our use case — the UI handles empty states separately.

verdict.summary: Type fix looks good. Keeping 0 for empty arrays per product spec.

issue_identification.rationale: Found 1 of 3 bugs (any cast). Missed cache key normalization and error handling. Level 2-3.

prioritization.rationale: Flagged type safety as suggestion, not blocking. Flagged empty array as suggestion. Reasonable for junior. Level 2-3.

revision_evaluation.rationale: Accepted Number(cached) fix without verifying it handles non-numeric strings. Accepted pushback on empty array without verifying product spec. Level 2-3.

reasoning_quality.rationale: Basic rationale for both comments. Some technical reasoning (type safety, math). Level 2-3.

question_formation.rationale: One implicit question about empty array behavior, but no explicit questions. Level 2-3.

ai_direction.rationale: Suggested Number(cached) — actionable but minimal. No guidance on cache key issue. Level 2-3.
